name: Mother Ignoring Kid Drowning In A Pool
look: Two stacked photos. Top: in an outdoor pool with palm trees behind, a smiling mother lifts a happy little girl in pigtails while a boy in the foreground struggles with only his panicked face above water. Bottom: a skeleton sits in a chair at the bottom of murky green water.
use: Shows attention going to something new while older things are neglected. The mother is labeled as someone, the happy girl as the new favorite, the struggling boy as the neglected older thing, and the skeleton below as something forgotten long ago.
slots: the mother: who is giving the attention
the happy girl: the new favorite
the struggling boy: what is being neglected
the skeleton underwater: what was forgotten long ago
examples: The hobby I started last month
The guitar I bought three years ago
